title: The Other Landing
intro: You know the sound of your own door.
warning: A short fictional horror story about knocking, darkness and a figure at a door. No gore, flashing images or sudden loud sounds. Sound is optional. You can stop at any time.

scenes.line: Three knocks. You were not expecting anyone.
scenes.caption: Three knocks at the front door.

scenes.line: The landing is empty. The light above your door is warm.
scenes.caption: A fluorescent hum. No footsteps.

scenes.line: The same three knocks. This time, from the bedroom.
scenes.caption: Three knocks behind you.

scenes.line: There has never been a bedroom door on this wall.
scenes.caption: The hum stops.

scenes.line: Your coat is missing from its hook. You can see the hem under the front door.
scenes.caption: Cloth brushes the other side of the door.

scenes.line: Your coat is standing on the landing. There is no head above its collar.
scenes.caption: A slow breath beyond the door.

scenes.line: The chain is on the other side now. Whoever is there has locked you in.
scenes.caption: The chain draws tight outside.

scenes.line: There is an eye at the peephole. It is looking out, in the same direction as you.
scenes.caption: Your knocks return from inside the flat.

scenes.line: You have been standing on the landing the whole time.
scenes.caption: A door closes softly behind you.

scenes.line: It opens inward. There is not room for both of you.
scenes.caption: Two breaths. One doorway.

controls.knockGuide: Tap your own rhythm. The other side will learn it.
controls.paused: Paused. Nothing moves or sounds until you resume.
controls.audioError: Sound is unavailable. The story still works silently.
